# Email and DM sequences

**Welcome, launch and re-engagement sequences by email and opt-in DM: consent first, law-compliant, labelled, never mass-DMed.**

Builds welcome, launch and re-engagement sequences by email and opt-in DMs for creators and AI characters — consent capture and double opt-in, CAN-SPAM, UK PECR/GDPR and CASL basics, Gmail/Yahoo/Outlook bulk-sender rules, platform DM rules (Instagram 24-hour window and comment-to-DM, X, Telegram, Discord, LinkedIn), and copy-paste templates with the AI label and footer built in. Use when someone wants an email welcome series, a launch email sequence, a win-back or list-cleaning campaign, a comment-to-DM flow or a Telegram bot sequence, or asks whether they can mass-DM followers or import a list.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Grow](../README.md) | intermediate | 2–3 h to build, 15 min a week | `@useclaudia/social` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Capture consent you can prove
2. Fix the footer and sending domain
3. Build the welcome sequence
4. Write the launch sequence
5. Run re-engagement every quarter
6. Add opt-in DM flows only
7. Keep a human on approval
8. Measure clicks, replies and complaints

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.
